name: Crime and arrests by county and state: violent and property crime, DUI and drug arrests (FBI)
description: What police agencies reported to the FBI over the last five complete calendar years, for every state and for 2,981 counties, home to 96.5% of U.S. residents: violent crimes, property crimes, arrests for driving under the influence, all arrests, and, for states and the United States, arrests for drug abuse violations, fraud, forgery and counterfeiting, and embezzlement. County rows add up the agencies the FBI places in each county (a city police department, a sheriff's office, a campus force; an agency that serves several counties counts in the county of its headquarters); a row says how many agencies there are and what share of the county's residents they cover, because each county counts only the months its agencies reported (never a zero in their place), and a county-year appears when at least one of its agencies reported. Rates are per 100,000 residents of the agencies that did report. State rows are the FBI's own state series; the county rows add up the agency-level answers, which can come to less than the state series where the FBI's state count includes reports its agency-level answers do not return. The United States row is the sum of the states. Only counts are published: no officer, victim, suspect or agency name.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Crime and arrests by county and state: violent and property crime, DUI and drug arrests (FBI) (Version 2.1.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24011321

distribution.name: crime-data.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: crime-data.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: crime-data-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in crime-data-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to crime-data.csv on id.

recordSet.name: crime-data
recordSet.description: The records of Crime and arrests by county and state: violent and property crime, DUI and drug arrests (FBI), one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter code of the state, or US

field.name: level
field.description: county (agencies the FBI places in that county), county-not-given (statewide, tribal, transit and other agencies that list no single county; they count in the state total), state (the FBI's own state series) or us (the sum of the states)

field.name: year
field.description: The latest full calendar year in the record

field.name: window
field.description: The five calendar years covered

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: DUI arrests reported in the latest year

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: violent_crimes
field.description: Violent crimes (murder, rape, robbery, aggravated assault) agencies reported in the latest year

field.name: property_crimes
field.description: Property crimes (burglary, larceny-theft, motor vehicle theft, arson) agencies reported in the latest year

field.name: dui_arrests
field.description: Arrests for driving under the influence reported in the latest year (FBI offense id 260)

field.name: all_arrests
field.description: All arrests reported in the latest year

field.name: violent_5y
field.description: Violent crimes over the years the record lists under years (the five-year window, or the years in which the county's agencies reported)

field.name: property_5y
field.description: Property crimes over the years the record lists under years (the five-year window, or the years in which the county's agencies reported)

field.name: dui_5y
field.description: DUI arrests over the years the record lists under years (the five-year window, or the years in which the county's agencies reported)

field.name: all_arrests_5y
field.description: All arrests over the years the record lists under years (the five-year window, or the years in which the county's agencies reported)

field.name: years_reported
field.description: How many calendar years of the window the record lists under years

field.name: coverage_offenses_pct
field.description: Share of those residents whose agencies reported offenses in the latest year, weighted by months reported (for every level, read from the agency answers; a year of zeros in every month from an agency serving 1,000 or more residents is left out of the months reported)

field.name: coverage_arrests_pct
field.description: Share of those residents whose agencies reported arrests in the latest year, weighted by months reported (read the same way as the offense coverage)

field.name: agencies
field.description: Agencies the FBI lists for the place (reporting or not)

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
